description:
Returns a paginated list of receipts with filtering and sorting options.
Supports multiple view types: Normal (default), Short, Compact, Mobile, and Id.

parameters.name: filters[received_at]
parameters.description:
Raw date range string for received_at filter. Format: [YYYY-MM-DD...YYYY-MM-DD] (e.g. [2026-01-01...2026-12-31]).
Setting this constructs Adapter.Api.Controller.rest.v2.ReceiptRequest.Read.Receipts...

parameters.name: filters[created_at]
parameters.description: Raw date range string for created_at filter. Format: [YYYY-MM-DD...YYYY-MM-DD] (e.g. [2026-01-01...2026-12-31]).

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description: Raw date range string for updated_at filter. Format: [YYYY-MM-DD...YYYY-MM-DD] (e.g. [2026-01-01...2026-12-31]).

parameters.name: filters[condition]
parameters.description: Receipt condition value; serialized in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE via Core.JsonConverters.UpperSnakeCaseConverter.

parameters.name: filters[location_received]
parameters.description: Location where the receipt was received.

parameters.name: filters[columns]
parameters.description: Comma-separated column keys controlling dynamic projection (e.g. "id,status,site").

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: The page size between 1 and 100. For Ids view the maximum page size is 5000.

parameters.name: filters[property_key]
parameters.description: Dynamic property key for document property filtering.

parameters.name: filters[property_value]
parameters.description: Dynamic property value for document property filtering.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort results by field. Prefix with '-' for descending order (e.g. '-created_at').

schema.description: Class representing a procore response with data.
